_comment: B-033 lifecycle for the Noah bucket (S3 PutBucketLifecycleConfiguration format; R2/MinIO accept the same rules). raw/ is provenance for append-only rows (guardrail 7) and is never expired. research/ is scratch for backtests. Apply with: aws s3api put-bucket-lifecycle-configuration --bucket $NOAH_S3_BUCKET --lifecycle-configuration file://config/object_storage_lifecycle.json (strip _comment first if your tool rejects unknown keys). Review retention with Ari before applying (budget, guardrail 14).
